exercises.title: PE-ADV style: InvalidStudentException, Student, StudentManager
exercises.problemHtml:
Write three classes used by the given Main:

  • InvalidStudentException extends Exception (constructor with a message).
  • Student(String id, String name, double mark) throws InvalidStudentException: id = "SE" + 4 digits, else "Invalid id: <id>"; name not blank, else "Name is required"; mark 0..10, else "Invalid mark: <mark>". Name stored trimmed.
  • StudentManager: add(Student s) throws InvalidStudentException ("Duplicate id: <id>"), List<Student> byMarkDesc() (mark high→low, then id), double average() (0 when empty).

Student’s toString() → "SE0001 | Nguyen An | 8.50".

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Do not change Main.java.
  • The exception is checked; Student and StudentManager declare it.

Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<thư-mục>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<thư-mục> — rồi node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<thư-mục> rồi node cham.mjs. Mẹo: gõ cd rồi kéo thư mục vào cửa sổ terminal. Cần Node.js 18+ và JDK 8 trở lên (khuyên 17 hoặc 21) — javac -version phải chạy được.

exercises.title: An Inputter for every LAB211 program
exercises.problemHtml:
Write Inputter, a small class you can drop into every LAB211 assignment. It receives the Scanner in its constructor (no static Scanner) and offers:

  • int readInt(String prompt, int min, int max) — errors: Please enter an integer. / Please enter a number from <min> to <max>.
  • double readDouble(String prompt, double min, double max) — same messages with a number instead of an integer; the range printed with String.valueOf.
  • String readString(String prompt, String regex, String error) — trimmed, must match regex, else print error; blank → This field is required.
  • String readDate(String prompt) — format dd/MM/yyyy and a real date (31/02/2026 is refused): Please enter a real date as dd/MM/yyyy.

Each method prints the prompt, reads a whole line, and asks again until the value is valid. Main (given) uses it to register a borrower.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Only nextLine(); the LAB211 rules L1–L7 are checked.
  • Do not change Main.java.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Every reader follows the same loop: prompt, read a line, try to convert, check the range or pattern, return only a valid value, and print a specific message otherwise. The exceptions thrown by parseInt / parseDouble / parse are caught inside the loop — they are expected user mistakes, not program errors.

Ngoại lệ do parseInt / parseDouble / parse ném được bắt trong vòng lặp — đó là lỗi người dùng có thể đoán trước, không phải lỗi chương trình.

exercises.title: Wrap and rethrow with a cause: parsing order lines
concepts: checked exception for a format error
exercises.problemHtml:
OrderParser.parse(String line, int lineNo) turns "SP001;3;15000" into an Order. Low-level failures (NumberFormatException, ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException) must not leak to the caller: wrap them in a checked OrderFormatException(int lineNo, String message, Throwable cause) whose message is "line 3: <message>":

  • fewer than 3 fields → message "expected code;quantity;price" (cause: the index exception, or none);
  • a field that is not a number → "not a number: <field>" (cause: the NumberFormatException);
  • quantity ≤ 0 or price < 0 → "quantity must be > 0" / "price must be >= 0" (no cause).

Main (given) prints the valid orders, each error with the class of its cause, and the total value.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • OrderFormatException is checked and passes the cause to super(message, cause).
  • Do not change Order.java or Main.java.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Exception translation: the parser speaks the caller’s language (OrderFormatException with a line number) while keeping the low-level exception as the cause for debugging. Validation errors that are not caused by another exception are thrown with a null cause.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Dịch ngoại lệ: bộ đọc nói ngôn ngữ của nơi gọi (OrderFormatException kèm số dòng) mà vẫn giữ ngoại lệ cấp thấp làm nguyên nhân để gỡ lỗi. Lỗi kiểm tra không do ngoại lệ khác gây ra thì ném với nguyên nhân null.

mistakesJson.loi: Throwing the new exception without the cause — the stack trace of the real problem is lost.|||Ném ngoại lệ mới mà không kèm nguyên nhân — mất stack trace của lỗi thật.

Catching OrderFormatException in a catch (Exception e) inside parse and re-wrapping it — the validation errors get a cause they should not have.|||Bắt OrderFormatException trong catch (Exception e) bên trong parse rồi bọc lại — lỗi kiểm tra bị gắn nguyên nhân không nên có.

"".split(";") gives [""], so an empty line fails on p[1] — it is the index exception that must be wrapped.|||"".split(";") cho [""], nên dòng trống hỏng ở p[1] — chính ngoại lệ chỉ số đó phải được bọc.

exercises.title: Exceptions through the layers: throw low, catch high
exercises.problemHtml:
A borrow request travels Controller → Service → Repository. Errors are thrown where they are discovered and caught only at the top, where a message can be shown:

  • BookRepository.find(String id) throws NotFoundException ("book B009 not found").
  • LoanService.borrow(String bookId, String member) throws NotFoundException, NotAvailableException: finds the book, refuses when no copy is left ("no copy of B002 left"), otherwise takes a copy. It catches nothing.
  • LoanController.handle(String bookId, String member) returns "OK B001 -> An" or "ERROR <message>", and in a finally block adds "audit B001 An" to the audit list (also for failures).

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • NotFoundException and NotAvailableException are checked.
  • Only the controller has try/catch.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Một yêu cầu mượn đi Controller → Service → Repository. Lỗi được ném ở nơi phát hiện và chỉ bắt ở trên cùng, nơi hiện được thông báo: Repository.find ném NotFoundException; LoanService.borrow ném NotFoundException hoặc NotAvailableException và không bắt gì; LoanController.handle trả "OK B001 -> An" hoặc "ERROR <message>" và trong finally ghi "audit B001 An" vào danh sách kiểm toán (cả khi thất bại). Câu báo như bản tiếng Anh.

Chạy máy chấm trên máy bạn

Website KHÔNG chấm bài này. Bấm Tải .zip ở khung code, giải nén, sửa code trong src/, rồi trong thư mục bài (thư mục chứa cham.mjs) chạy:

node cham.mjs

Giải nén ra một thư mục mang tên bài (gọi là <thư-mục>). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<thư-mục>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<thư-mục> — rồi node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<thư-mục> rồi node cham.mjs. Mẹo: gõ cd rồi kéo thư mục vào cửa sổ terminal. Cần Node.js 18+ và JDK 8 trở lên (khuyên 17 hoặc 21) — javac -version phải chạy được.

Máy chấm biên dịch src/ bằng javac, chạy 2 ca (1 ca ẩn — không in trong đề), so output từng dòng (bỏ qua khoảng trắng cuối dòng và kiểu xuống dòng Windows/macOS), in diff dòng sai, soát luật mã nguồn rồi cho điểm. In ALL CHECKS PASSED ⇒ quay lại đây bấm Tự đánh dấu đã giải. node cham.mjs --case 2 --show in input và toàn bộ output của bạn cho ca 2.

Yêu cầu

  • NotFoundException và NotAvailableException là checked.
  • Chỉ controller có try/catch.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Throw where the problem is found (repository, service), catch where something meaningful can be done (the controller turns it into a message). Checked exceptions document the path in every signature; finally guarantees the audit line for both outcomes.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Ném ở nơi phát hiện vấn đề (repository, service), bắt ở nơi làm được điều có nghĩa (controller biến nó thành câu thông báo). Ngoại lệ checked ghi rõ đường đi trong mọi chữ ký; finally bảo đảm dòng kiểm toán cho cả hai kết quả.

mistakesJson.loi: Catching in the service and returning null/false — the controller no longer knows WHY it failed (rule R1).|||Bắt ở service rồi trả null/false — controller không còn biết VÌ SAO thất bại (luật R1).
Auditing only on success — the audit must record every request, so it belongs in finally.|||Chỉ ghi kiểm toán khi thành công — kiểm toán phải ghi mọi yêu cầu, nên thuộc về finally.
copies.get(id) returning null unboxed into int — NullPointerException instead of NotFoundException.|||copies.get(id) trả null rồi tự mở hộp thành int — NullPointerException thay vì NotFoundException.
